metadata.title: The Universe of Computer Science
metadata.subtitle: An interactive atlas of research fields, foundations, systems, applications, and cross-cutting constellations.
metadata.content_note: Field boundaries, representative venues, book choices, and two-dimensional positions are editorial approximations rather than objective rankings. Editions and venue scopes should be reviewed periodically.
taxonomy_principles: Domains are broad navigation regions, not mutually exclusive departments.
Ordinary fields are established research communities at roughly comparable granularity.
Bridge fields may have more than one domain parent.
Constellations are cross-cutting umbrellas, methodologies, ecosystems, or application themes and are not ordinary children.
Hierarchy and conceptual relationships are stored separately.
Journals and conferences are separated and described as representative rather than ranked.

x.name: abstract_to_concrete
x.definition: Lower values emphasize mathematical or conceptual abstraction; higher values emphasize physical systems, deployed artifacts, or direct application.

y.name: machine_to_human
y.definition: Lower values primarily study computational machinery or formal mechanisms; higher values study people, institutions, experience, or social consequences.

views.name: Landscape
views.purpose: Show conceptual position using the two axes.
views.edge_behavior: Reveal direct typed relations on hover or selection.

views.name: Connections
views.purpose: Explore intellectual relationships from a selected field.

views.name: Taxonomy
views.purpose: Browse domains, ordinary fields, bridge fields, and constellations.

relation_types.label: Uses methods from
relation_types.description: The source substantially uses techniques from the target.

relation_types.label: Theoretical foundation for
relation_types.description: The source supplies formal foundations or guarantees for the target.

relation_types.label: Systems foundation for
relation_types.description: The source supplies infrastructure for the target.

relation_types.label: Overlaps with
relation_types.description: The fields share questions, methods, communities, or artifacts.

relation_types.label: Applied to
relation_types.description: Methods from the source are widely applied to the target.

relation_types.label: Synthesizes
relation_types.description: A constellation is formed by several component fields.

domains.name: Theory & Algorithms
domains.summary: The mathematical study of computation, efficient algorithms, computational limits, and rigorous guarantees.

domains.name: Mathematical, Statistical & Optimization Foundations
domains.summary: Mathematical languages and methods used throughout computer science.

domains.name: Computer Systems
domains.summary: The hardware and software infrastructure that executes programs, communicates, and stores information.

domains.name: Programming Languages & Software Engineering
domains.summary: The meaning, implementation, construction, analysis, and maintenance of software.

domains.name: Data & Information
domains.summary: The representation, storage, retrieval, integration, and discovery of information.

domains.name: Artificial Intelligence
domains.summary: Computational systems that perceive, reason, learn, communicate, decide, and act.

domains.name: Graphics, Visualization & Interaction
domains.summary: The synthesis and presentation of visual content and the design and study of interactive systems.

domains.name: Security & Privacy
domains.summary: The protection of systems, communications, hardware, software, and information under adversarial behavior.

domains.name: Computational Science & Interdisciplinary Computing
domains.summary: Computational research organized around scientific, medical, social, cultural, geographic, or environmental domains.

domains.name: Computing, Society & Education
domains.summary: Computing as a social institution, profession, environmental force, and subject people teach and learn.

fields.name: Automata, Formal Languages & Computability
fields.summary: Formal models of computation, language recognition, decidability, and the boundary between computable and uncomputable problems.

books.title: Introduction to the Theory of Computation

fields.name: Computational Complexity
fields.summary: The resources required to solve problems under models such as time, space, communication, randomness, and queries.

fields.name: Algorithms & Data Structures
fields.summary: The design and analysis of efficient procedures and representations for computational problems.

fields.name: Cryptography
fields.summary: Protocols that protect information and computation using formal adversarial models and computational hardness.

fields.name: Quantum Computing & Information
fields.summary: Quantum models of computation and information, including algorithms, complexity, communication, error correction, and realization.

fields.name: Computational Learning Theory
fields.summary: The proof-oriented study of learnability, generalization, sample complexity, online learning, and computational limits of learning.

books.title: Understanding Machine Learning: From Theory to Algorithms

fields.name: Algorithmic Economics & Game Theory
fields.summary: Algorithms and computational questions arising from strategic agents, incentives, markets, and collective choice.

journals: ACM Transactions on Economics and Computation

fields.name: Discrete Mathematics & Logic
fields.summary: Discrete structures and proof systems used to model computation.

journals: Annals of Pure and Applied Logic

fields.name: Probability & Statistics
fields.summary: Mathematical frameworks for uncertainty, inference, estimation, evidence, and stochastic processes.

journals: Journal of the American Statistical Association

fields.name: Optimization
fields.summary: Selecting optimal or near-optimal decisions under objectives, constraints, uncertainty, and computational limits.

fields.name: Information Theory & Coding
fields.summary: The quantitative study of information, compression, communication, coding, and inference under noise.

fields.name: Numerical Analysis
fields.summary: Algorithms that approximate continuous mathematical problems, with emphasis on error, stability, conditioning, and convergence.

fields.name: Computer Architecture & Organization
fields.summary: Instruction sets, processors, accelerators, memory hierarchies, performance, and hardware–software interfaces.

journals: ACM Transactions on Architecture and Code Optimization

fields.name: Operating Systems
fields.summary: Resource management, processes, virtual memory, storage, filesystems, concurrency, isolation, and virtualization.

fields.name: Networking & Communication
fields.summary: Protocols and systems for communication across wired, wireless, mobile, and large-scale networks.

fields.name: Parallel & Distributed Systems
fields.summary: Computation across multiple processors or machines, including coordination, consistency, scalability, and fault tolerance.

journals: IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems

fields.name: Storage Systems
fields.summary: Persistent storage, filesystems, caching, replication, storage hardware, and reliable access to large data collections.

books.title: Database Internals
books.coverage_note: Focuses on storage engines and distributed data systems.

fields.name: Cloud & Datacenter Systems
fields.summary: Large-scale infrastructure, including datacenter architecture, scheduling, virtualization, service operation, and energy efficiency.

fields.name: Embedded, Real-Time & Cyber-Physical Systems
fields.summary: Computing embedded in physical environments under timing, safety, sensing, actuation, energy, and reliability constraints.

journals: ACM Transactions on Embedded Computing Systems

books.title: Introduction to Embedded Systems: A Cyber-Physical Systems Approach

fields.name: Programming Languages & Semantics
fields.summary: Language design, type systems, semantics, paradigms, modules, effects, and reasoning about programs.

journals: ACM Transactions on Programming Languages and Systems

fields.name: Compilers & Runtime Systems
fields.summary: Translation and execution through parsing, intermediate representations, optimization, code generation, interpretation, and runtimes.

journals: ACM Transactions on Architecture and Code Optimization

fields.name: Program Analysis, Verification & Synthesis
fields.summary: Techniques for extracting program properties, proving correctness, finding defects, or constructing programs from specifications.

journals: ACM Transactions on Programming Languages and Systems

fields.name: Software Engineering
fields.summary: The systematic design, construction, collaboration, evolution, and empirical study of complex software systems.

journals: ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology

fields.name: Software Testing, Reliability & Maintenance
fields.summary: Methods for detecting defects, debugging, measuring reliability, repairing failures, and sustaining software over time.

fields.name: Databases & Data Management
fields.summary: Data models, query languages, transactions, indexing, storage, consistency, and efficient structured-data management.

fields.name: Data Systems & Engineering
fields.summary: Infrastructure for integrating, transporting, processing, monitoring, and governing batch and streaming data.

journals: IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering

fields.name: Information Retrieval & Search
fields.summary: Indexing, ranking, recommendation, relevance, and evaluation for locating useful information in large collections.

fields.name: Data Mining & Knowledge Discovery
fields.summary: The extraction of patterns, structures, associations, anomalies, and useful knowledge from data.

journals: ACM Transactions on Knowledge Discovery from Data

fields.name: Knowledge Graphs & Semantic Data
fields.summary: Structured representations of entities, relations, and semantics for integration, reasoning, querying, and discovery.

fields.name: Search, Planning & Decision-Making
fields.summary: Algorithms for exploring possibilities, constructing plans, and choosing actions under certainty or uncertainty.

fields.name: Knowledge Representation & Reasoning
fields.summary: Formal representations of facts, concepts, rules, beliefs, and relations, together with methods for deriving conclusions.

fields.name: Machine Learning
fields.summary: Algorithms that improve predictions, representations, or decisions from data or experience.

fields.name: Natural Language & Speech
fields.summary: Computational models of language, speech, meaning, dialogue, translation, retrieval, and generation.

journals: Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics

fields.name: Computer Vision & Perception
fields.summary: Computational interpretation of images, video, geometry, scenes, and other sensory signals.

journals: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence

fields.name: Robotics & Autonomous Systems
fields.summary: Perception, estimation, planning, learning, control, and physical action in autonomous machines.

journals: The International Journal of Robotics Research

books.title: Modern Robotics: Mechanics, Planning, and Control

fields.name: Multiagent Systems
fields.summary: Interacting computational agents that cooperate, compete, communicate, negotiate, and make distributed decisions.

books.title: Multiagent Systems: Algorithmic, Game-Theoretic, and Logical Foundations

fields.name: Computer Graphics
fields.summary: The representation, synthesis, simulation, animation, and rendering of visual and geometric content.

fields.name: Visualization
fields.summary: The visual representation of data and abstract information for exploration, analysis, explanation, and communication.

journals: IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics

fields.name: Human-Computer Interaction
fields.summary: The design, use, and evaluation of interactive computing systems in human, organizational, and cultural contexts.

fields.name: Accessibility & Inclusive Computing
fields.summary: Technologies and design methods that make computing usable across differing abilities, bodies, languages, and circumstances.

books.title: Ensuring Digital Accessibility through Process and Policy

fields.name: Computer-Supported Cooperative Work & Social Computing
fields.summary: Systems that mediate collaboration, communication, communities, platforms, and collective activity.

journals: Proceedings of the ACM on Human-Computer Interaction

books.title: Readings in Groupware and Computer-Supported Cooperative Work

fields.name: Games & Interactive Media
fields.summary: Interactive entertainment and expressive systems, including engines, game AI, procedural content, and player experience.

fields.name: Virtual, Augmented & Mixed Reality
fields.summary: Immersive and spatial computing involving displays, tracking, perception, simulation, and interaction.

journals: IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics

fields.name: Systems & Software Security
fields.summary: Vulnerabilities, exploitation, malware, isolation, secure design, and defensive mechanisms in software systems.

journals: ACM Transactions on Privacy and Security
IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing
conferences: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy

fields.name: Network Security
fields.summary: Attacks and defenses involving communication protocols, distributed services, and network infrastructure.

journals: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security
IEEE Transactions on Network and Service Management

books.title: Network Security: Private Communication in a Public World

fields.name: Hardware Security
fields.summary: Side channels, secure processors, trusted execution, physical attacks, supply chains, and hardware roots of trust.

journals: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security

books.title: Introduction to Hardware Security and Trust

fields.name: Applied Cryptography
fields.summary: The construction, implementation, deployment, and evaluation of cryptographic protocols in real systems.

books.title: A Graduate Course in Applied Cryptography

fields.name: Privacy-Enhancing Technologies
fields.summary: Technical methods that enable useful computation while limiting disclosure of sensitive information.

books.title: The Algorithmic Foundations of Differential Privacy
books.coverage_note: Covers differential privacy rather than the full PET landscape.

fields.name: Usable Security & Privacy
fields.summary: How security and privacy mechanisms interact with human behavior, understanding, incentives, and decisions.

journals: ACM Transactions on Privacy and Security

fields.name: Digital Forensics
fields.summary: The acquisition, preservation, reconstruction, analysis, and interpretation of digital evidence.

fields.name: Numerical & Scientific Computing
fields.summary: Simulation, numerical models, scientific software, and high-performance computation for scientific discovery.

fields.name: Computational Biology & Bioinformatics
fields.summary: Computational study of biological sequences, structures, evolution, molecular systems, genomics, and biological data.

fields.name: Health Informatics & Computational Medicine
fields.summary: Clinical information, medical data, decision support, biomedical modeling, diagnosis, treatment, and healthcare systems.

journals: Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association

fields.name: Computational Social Science
fields.summary: The computational study of social behavior, networks, institutions, communication, and collective phenomena.

books.title: Bit by Bit: Social Research in the Digital Age

fields.name: Digital Humanities
fields.summary: Computational approaches to literature, history, archives, language, art, and cultural artifacts.

fields.name: Geospatial & Urban Computing
fields.summary: Spatial data, geographic systems, mobility, transportation, remote sensing, cities, and urban infrastructure.

journals: International Journal of Geographical Information Science

fields.name: Computational Sustainability
fields.summary: Computational methods for conservation, climate, energy, agriculture, resource allocation, and environmental decisions.

fields.name: Ethics, Fairness & Accountability
fields.summary: Normative analysis of computational systems, including discrimination, transparency, responsibility, power, and evaluation.

fields.name: Computing Law, Policy & Governance
fields.summary: Regulation, intellectual property, platform governance, competition, privacy law, cybersecurity policy, and institutions.

fields.name: Social Impacts of Computing
fields.summary: The effects of computing on work, communities, politics, culture, inequality, institutions, and everyday life.

books.title: Technology and Society: Building Our Sociotechnical Future

fields.name: Computer Science Education
fields.summary: The teaching and learning of computing, including curriculum, assessment, misconceptions, participation, and educational tools.

books.title: The Cambridge Handbook of Computing Education Research

fields.name: Computing Profession & Practice
fields.summary: Professional responsibility, research and engineering practice, standards, organizations, and professional obligations.

books.title: The Mythical Man-Month
books.coverage_note: Classic perspective on professional software projects, not a complete survey.

fields.name: Sustainable Computing & Environmental Impact
fields.summary: The energy, carbon, water, material, and lifecycle costs of computing infrastructure, devices, software, and AI.

constellations.name: Data Science
constellations.summary: A cross-cutting practice combining statistics, data management, engineering, machine learning, visualization, and domain expertise.
constellations.why_not_ordinary_child: It is not contained by one research domain and overlaps several established communities.

constellations.name: Neuro-Symbolic AI
constellations.summary: Approaches that combine learned representations with symbolic structure, logic, constraints, or explicit reasoning.
constellations.why_not_ordinary_child: Its identity is the bridge between machine learning and symbolic reasoning, not membership under one parent.

constellations.name: Embodied AI
constellations.summary: Intelligence developed and evaluated through perception and action in physical or simulated environments.
constellations.why_not_ordinary_child: It spans robotics, perception, learning, simulation, and hardware rather than forming a clean child of AI.

journals: The International Journal of Robotics Research

constellations.name: Human–AI Interaction
constellations.summary: The design and study of interaction, collaboration, explanation, control, and reliance between people and AI systems.
constellations.why_not_ordinary_child: It requires both AI-system behavior and human-centered evaluation, with ethical and institutional dimensions.

journals: ACM Transactions on Interactive Intelligent Systems

constellations.name: Trustworthy AI
constellations.summary: An umbrella for reliability, robustness, safety, security, privacy, fairness, accountability, and human control in AI.
constellations.why_not_ordinary_child: Trustworthiness is a collection of desired properties studied by several communities, not one coherent child field.

constellations.name: Multimodal Learning
constellations.summary: Learning systems that integrate information from language, vision, audio, and other modalities.
constellations.why_not_ordinary_child: It combines established perception and language fields through shared learning methods.

journals: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence

constellations.name: AI for Science
constellations.summary: The use and adaptation of AI for scientific modeling, simulation, experiment design, and discovery.
constellations.why_not_ordinary_child: Its methods and evaluation depend simultaneously on AI and domain-specific scientific practice.

constellations.name: Internet of Things
constellations.summary: Networked sensing and actuation ecosystems built from embedded devices, communication, data services, security, and interaction.
constellations.why_not_ordinary_child: IoT is an ecosystem assembled from several systems and application fields rather than a single foundational community.

constellations.name: Developer Tools
constellations.summary: Interactive tools that help people understand, write, test, debug, transform, and maintain software.
constellations.why_not_ordinary_child: Developer tools combine software engineering, program analysis, HCI, and increasingly AI.

constellations.name: Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning
constellations.summary: Learning and inference under formal privacy, cryptographic, distributed, or disclosure constraints.
constellations.why_not_ordinary_child: It applies privacy and cryptographic guarantees to learning systems, so neither security nor AI alone contains it.

constellations.name: Computational Social Choice
constellations.summary: Computational and axiomatic analysis of voting, collective decisions, preference aggregation, and fair allocation.
constellations.why_not_ordinary_child: It bridges algorithmic game theory, political institutions, and computational social analysis.
